mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND name LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT popup_id::TEXT AS row_id, name AS popup_name, start_dt, end_dt, link_url, content, sort_no, width, height, pos_top, pos_left, (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = popup.popup_id AND r.file_type = 'POPUP' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id FROM popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (start_dt IS NULL OR start_dt = '' OR start_dt <= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt = '' OR end_dt >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY sort_no, popup_id

SELECT popup_id::TEXT AS row_id, name AS popup_name, start_dt, end_dt, link_url, content, sort_no, width, height, pos_top, pos_left, use_yn, (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = popup.popup_id AND r.file_type = 'POPUP' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id FROM popup WHERE popup_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup (name, start_dt, end_dt, link_url, content, sort_no, width, height, pos_top, pos_left, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{popupName}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{linkUrl}, #{content}, -- 전역 마지막(사용중) 순서+1 자동 부여 COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) + 1 FROM popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y')), #{width}, #{height}, #{posTop}, #{posLeft}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE popup SET name = #{popupName}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, content = #{content}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, pos_top = #{posTop}, pos_left = #{posLeft}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE popup_id = #{rowId}::integer

AND sort_no < #{sortNo}::integer ORDER BY sort_no DESC
AND sort_no > #{sortNo}::integer ORDER BY sort_no ASC

mapper.update: UPDATE popup SET sort_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE popup_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE popup SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE popup_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE popup SET sort_no = sort_no - 1, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND sort_no > (SELECT sort_no FROM popup WHERE popup_id = #{rowId}::integer)
